\section*{Application API ratios}
Each ratio divides SciPy median time by the listed API median time over three rounds in the same environment and pipeline. Values above one favor the listed API. Assignment replay uses the same captured float32 costs across APIs. Tracker updates start from prepared detections. S4 retains absolute times and round estimates.
